# Astronomical 0.2.39
## Memory serving fixes
- Streaming under memory pressure keeps its activation promise per request shape. The forward transient reserve is resolved by the planned execution shape — exact context first, then token-proportional, then the global maximum — instead of a session-wide global maximum. Sparse MoE models under tight ceilings keep streaming from SSD instead of being silently promoted to resident mid-request. - The prefill activation promise is now scoped by planned context. Activation evidence is recorded per 1,024-token context bucket with proportional projection beyond measured contexts, so one large request no longer shrinks expert retention for every later request. Decode keeps its scalar high-water evidence and the first decode stays protected by the largest prefill observation.
## Menu-bar app
- The menu-bar app shows a first-run welcome window once per versioned moment. It introduces the daemon, the model library, and the privacy posture to new users, and stays quiet on ordinary updates.
## Maintenance
- Memory budget, residency planning, and engine execution sources were split at cohesive module boundaries with no behavior change, keeping the source-size guard budget intact. - Dependency update: async-openai 0.42.0.
## Compatibility
- No REST API compatibility constraints apply. - Configuration, model library, and prompt cache state are preserved across the update. - Distributed as a signed and notarized DMG with a signed Sparkle update feed.
